safe.hudTopBand: y<269 (pills y34-110, phase/brother row y120-196, strip y202-256). Delta chip fixed y284. Cards start y~286-300. Keep callouts/stamps y>=300
safe.captionHigh: cap:'high': band y340-496 (centre 22%); use when action is low in frame

lakeSide.shows: Side view: sky+sun+pine shoreline, 3 shacks (red one, smoke, lit window, door at far right), lake plane in perspective, footprint trail, creek mouth thin-ice tongue, hole (ellipse) when world.hole>0. Same component/canvas as lakeCut

coords.creekChannel: x1000 vertical notch through pines at horizon (y640-764)
coords.shacks: x1960(y812 grey) x2130(y818 tan) x2310(y824 RED, door ~x2330,y872, chimney smoke)

props.trailGlow: 0..1 green glow over footprint trail door->hole, prints turn green
props.edgeLip: 0|1 raised unbroken ice edge right of hole x1168-1500,y~1300 (needs world.hole>0.9); forearms rest on it
props.chips: 0|1 flying ice chips at pick tips; offset from first non-ghost eli figure (x+330*scale)
props.dim: 0|1 white dimension line hole rim (x1212) to Eli (needs eli figure), at y1460, NO text; add own callout (e.g. '3 M')
props.door: 0..1 red shack door swings open + light spill

framings: v(2380,1000,1.35,840) linear follow:true walker near shack
v(1000,1215,2.4,780)->3.0 close on head/shoulders in hole

lakeCut.shows: Cross-section directly under the side view: ice slab (10px=1cm; 60px/6cm thin at x1000, ramps to 150px/15cm beyond |x-1000|>560), dark creek water with current arrows+bubbles, lake bed y3520. Hole = gap of 150*hole each side of x1000

coords.figureRule: figure y = CUT_WL + 226*scale; sub:{y:CUT_WL,tint:true} (dark water tint instead of clip)

props.current: 0..1 default 0.35: opacity of blue current arrows streaming right under ice (use 0.4-1 on creek shots)
props.ruler: 0..1 yellow 11cm ruler grows at x1262 from ice top + dashed line to hole edge (measure 6cm)
props.air: 0..1 pale air pockets + rising arrows on jacket below waterline of first non-ghost eli (sub.y+22)
props.dArrow: 0|1 red dashed DOWN arrow at (1350,1545+bob) 'jacket drags you down' myth

lakeTop.shows: Plan/map view: shore pines top/sides, creek entering top at x392-448 with thin tongue to hole, 3 huts (y~370, x770/862/952, red at 952 w/ smoke), 16 old fishing holes, footprints door->hole (always drawn), hole (r19 at hole=1)+cracks, people as top-down symbols

props.arrows|arrowsAt: 0..1 or fraction-of-shot; 4 white direction arrows from hole (name+'At' overrides: value = shot fraction when it ramps over 0.1)
props.keep|keepAt: 0..1 (or At fraction): 3 arrows fade, remaining one grows green and points along footprints to shack (TURN BACK)
props.trailGlow|trailGlowAt: 0..1 (or At fraction): green glow on footprint line door->hole
props.broPath: 0..1 opacity: red dashed straight path door->hole + dashed red ring r46 at hole
props.bro0: 0..1 brother progress along door->hole at shot start
props.broShow: 0..1 opacity of top-down brother runner (needs bro0/bro1)
props.eli: bool draw top-down Eli at (1.6 + roll*3) m from hole toward shack
props.roll1: 0..1 end (default=roll0); also drives wet drag line from hole to Eli
props.spread: 0..1 green dashed weight circles under limbs (needs eli)

framings: v(540,1150,0.4,1040,330)->v(540,1150,0.9,1040,330) snap:8 whip:true flash:'white' (map reveal: hole centred at x330 so right side has room)
v(556,1127,6,800)->v(566,1112,6,800) linear: 6x close on top-down Eli rolling (people true scale ~26px)

lakePrint.shows: Close-up plate: one boot print in pink-lit snow, radiating crack star (world.crack), Eli: two boots, right boot steps in over first ~50% of shot; brother: bigger lug-tread print, snow dots, no boots/crack

black.shows: NOTHING drawn (dark #0b0d12 bg); HUD/events/captions/particles still render. Use for hard cuts or card-only beats

Cam.y: world y at screen centre (screen y960)

camera.v(wx,wy,zoom,sy=900,sx=540): returns Cam placing world point (wx,wy) at screen (sx,sy): x=wx-(sx-540)/zoom, y=wy-(sy-960)/zoom. Default sy=900 (slightly above centre, leaves lower third for captions). Pass sy 1080 for wide shots with horizon low

shotFields.to: Cam end (omit = locked; always-on tiny drift)
shotFields.linear: linear instead of cubic ease-in-out (trucks, follow)
shotFields.snap: N frames: camera completes move in N frames then stays locked (whip-zoom, use 6-8)
shotFields.follow: camera adds the first non-ghost figure with walk:true or to{} displacement

heroIds.eli: adult angler: orange puffy jacket, teal beanie, ice picks on cord (use pose waterPicks/picks)
heroIds.brother: taller, green plaid parka, trapper hat, beard

extra.zipper: front view both hands at zipper (ghost use)
extra.waterPicks: chest-deep, picks raised in both fists
extra.kickMorph: over the shot: upright-ish -> kicking -> flat (use scale 0.75 in lakeCut, with 'to')
extra.lie: flat on stomach, arms forward, wet shivering

fields.hold: 0..1 fraction of shot after which motion/anim freezes
fields.walk: true: x advances 14*scale/frame, feet planted (x ignores to.x)
fields.sub: {y,x?,tint?} waterline y (world); body clipped below it; x: region right of x stays dry; tint:true = dark water rect instead (use in lakeCut)
fields.ghost: red dashed double (drawn above freeze filter, only in lake scenes); needs separate Figure
fields.rise: 0..1 ghost rises out of real figure by this shot fraction
fields.cross: shot fraction red X lands on ghost
fields.shatter: shot fraction ghost shatters like thin ice
fields.noop: head, morph (accepted by type, NOT read by renderer)

helpers.feetRule: submerged figure feet y = waterline + 226*scale (chest at waterline); onIce +198*scale; raised waterThree +176*scale
helpers.FROZEN: {speed:0} spread onto a figure for frozen-world shots

light.LightMode: dusk|freeze|bluehour|night — NOTE: Shot.light is NOT read by any renderer (no-op). Look comes from world.dusk (tint/sky/stars/snow colour) and world.freeze. Keep setting it for readability only
light.lookByWorld: dusk 0 = low pink sun, warm tint; ~0.5 purple, sun gone at ~0.58; 0.78 blue-hour; 1 = deep violet night, stars, lit shack windows. freeze>0 = blue monochrome (ghosts stay red) and snow stops

world.note: State at END of shot; interpolates from previous over worldT (default 0.55 of shot); carried forward forever; initial all 0
world.dusk: 0..1 time of day (16:18 pink sun -> night with stars)
world.crack: 0..1 crack star grows (lakeSide plane at hole pos, lakePrint around print)
world.hole: 0..1 hole opens (plane ellipse, cut gap, top circle+cracks, ice plates, footprints from door to hole all shown)
world.wet: 0..1 dark wet drag trail from hole toward x1700 (side) / Eli (top)

particles.default: SHOTS map applies 'snow' to every shot; 170 flakes; stop moving when freeze>0.5

hud.note: Merged forward shot to shot (set only changes); numbers ease over hudT (default 0.6); mode switches at shot start. Initial: mode clock, clock 978, ghost true (clock pill 35% opacity), ice undefined, water false, phase none, strip false, brother null
hud.mode: 'clock' -> pill 'DEC · h:mm' (HARDCODED 'DEC'); 'water' -> 'IN WATER mm:ss' (red); 'paused' -> 'PAUSED mm:ss' (blue); 'out' -> 'OUT mm:ss' (green)
hud.timer: seconds since fall (for water/paused/out modes and the strip fill)
hud.ice: number cm -> pill 'ICE n cm' (red if <10); null -> 'ICE -- cm'; undefined/never set = no pill
hud.strip: true -> pinned bar: '1 MIN' / '≈10 MIN · GET OUT' / '≈1 HR · PASS OUT'; middle fills from timer 60..600 s
hud.brother: number -> pill 'BROTHER n M' (red, hardcoded); null hides
hud.ghost: true = clock pill at 35%; set false when story starts
hud.ticks: Ev kind 'tick' with pill 'clock'|'ice'|'water'|'phase'|'strip'|'brother' flashes that pill white ~9 frames at `at`; pills also auto-flash when their text changes. Tick has no visual of its own

events.common: at: 0..1 fraction of shot (required); dur: seconds on screen

optional: target [wx,wy] WORLD point -> dashed leader + dot, follows camera
mark:true -> yellow '?' disc drawn at target (or pos), text is the glyph

delta.look: chip fixed at y284 under HUD, no pos

optional: dur seconds (omit = until end of shot)

opts.cont: bool: skip pop-in (continuing from previous shot's title)

title.validFor: only the 'ten minutes not seconds' hook; do not use for other episodes

ladder.text: HARDCODED Minnesota DNR new-clear-ice table: header 'NEW CLEAR ICE · MINNESOTA DNR'; rungs 40-43 CM HEAVY-DUTY TRUCK .. 13-18 CM SNOWMOBILE / SMALL ATV; '10 CM 4 IN · ON FOOT'; red 'UNDER 10 CM · STAY OFF' with '6 CM · ELI' chip; footer 'NO ICE IS 100% SAFE · THICKNESS VARIES ACROSS A LAKE'
ladder.validFor: only ice-thickness-safety topics; the '6 CM · ELI' chip is episode-specific

oneTenOne.text: HARDCODED '1 · 10 · 1', '1 MIN BREATHE', '≈10 MIN GET OUT', '≈1 HR PASS OUT', 'ARM STRENGTH', chip '1-10-1 PRINCIPLE · CITED BY MN DNR'
oneTenOne.validFor: any cold-water-immersion 1-10-1 explanation; set chip:false unless MN DNR is cited

phone911.text: HARDCODED phone in zip bag '911 CALLING…' + shack icon (red hut, lit window) + 'GET WARM'
phone911.validFor: any 'get warm / call 911' beat after rescue; shows a red fishing shack

angle.text: HARDCODED 'BODY ANGLE' + live degrees; turns green below 8°

part2.validFor: series end card for any episode with a sequel

opts.text: label, default 'WHITE ICE ≈ ½ AS STRONG'

swatch.validFor: clear-vs-white ice comparison; ALWAYS pass opts.text for other topics (default is episode text)

limits: Edit ONLY src/shots.ts data. Keep `export const TITLE` (string, slug), `export const LINES`, `export const SHOTS: Shot[]`, type-only imports `import type { Cam } from "./camera"; import type { Figure, Shot } from "./types"` (no runtime imports, no new components/files).

LINES: {text:string, highlight:string[]}. highlight entries are lowercase words as in the line (punctuation stripped, hyphens/apostrophes kept: "brother's", "nine-one-one"), optional ":r" red, ":g" green, ":p" purple, default gold. ONE coloured word per caption phrase (phrase <=6 words/~30 chars; last match in phrase wins); extra matches silently ignored.

Every Shot.line must be a valid LINES index; every LINES index needs >=1 shot (else its time has no shot and the render falls back to the last shot). Shots are grouped by line; order inside a line = array order.
weight = relative share of that line's time (author in seconds summing to ~line speech+0.3 s; est. words/2.6 + 0.3 until voice exists); last shot of a line takes the remainder. Default weight 1.
Scene must be one of lakeSide|lakeCut|lakeTop|lakePrint|black. props values only number|boolean|string and only keys listed per scene; unknown keys are silently ignored.

figures: id only 'eli'|'brother'; pose/view/expr only from lists (typecheck fails otherwise). Figures render only in lakeSide/lakeCut (ghosts too); lakeTop/lakePrint ignore figures (use props.eli/broShow/who).

Events: callout.pos and stamp.pos/tag.pos/bubble.pos are SCREEN px (1080x1920); callout.target is WORLD coords. callout pos and target required types are [number,number]. stamp needs color; card needs a card id from the list.

hud/world are cumulative: set a field once and it persists; reset explicitly (hud.ice:null, phase:'none', strip:false, water:false, brother:null; world.freeze:0). 'ghost' initial true: set hud:{ghost:false} on the first shot after the hook.
Camera: from required; every Cam needs x,y,zoom (use v()). Do not exceed zoom ~0.4 (min) or 6 (max); lakeTop zoom 0.4 shows the whole map.
Hole-dependent visuals (footprints, hole ellipse, cut gap, edgeLip, plates) need world.hole>0. Figures in the hole must use sub, with y = waterline + 226*scale.
